description: This Java class, AttachmentsRepo, manages storing, retrieving, and deleting attachment files within an Android application. It handles writing content from a URI into private storage, generating file URIs via FileProvider, and managing attachments in the app's private directory.

classes.name: AttachmentsRepo
classes.description: A final class responsible for managing attachment files, including writing content from URIs, deleting all stored attachments, and retrieving all attachment URIs.

methods.name: AttachmentsRepo(@NonNull Context)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repo with the application context and sets up the attachments directory.

methods.name: write(@NonNull Uri)
methods.description: Reads content from the given URI, writes it into the private storage directory, and returns a URI referencing the stored file.

methods.name: deleteAll()
methods.description: Deletes all attachment files stored in the attachments directory.

methods.name: getAllUris()
methods.description: Returns an immutable list of URIs referencing all stored attachment files.

methods.name: getUriForFile(@NonNull File)
methods.description: Generates a content URI for the specified file using FileProvider.
